sourceAuthority: continuous simulator RGB and calibrated positions

definitions.label: 赛博朋克
definitions.description: 粉青交替，霓虹循着轮廓前行。
definitions.rules: phase=(_frame*4+i*42)%512; corresponding phase moves -4/42 LEDs/source frame; mirrored left/right; diagonal highlights move upper-left; rare localized glitch

definitions.label: 黑客帝国
definitions.description: 绿光逐次亮起，数字光雨缓缓落下。
definitions.rules: independent random LED triggers, brightness decay 15/source frame; no LED chase; source-triggered background heads fall downward

definitions.label: 森林
definitions.description: 绿意层层起伏，萤光在林间闪动。
definitions.rules: canopy=sin255(_frame*3+i*32), understory=sin255(_frame*2+i*19+80); main phase moves -3/32 LEDs/frame, secondary -2/19; brief firefly when (_frame+i*9)%47==0; green tones and yellow-green flashes

definitions.label: 海洋
definitions.description: 蓝青波纹交错，光沿轮廓流动。
definitions.rules: w1=sin255(_frame*3+i*30), w2=sin255(_frame*2+i*50+128); phases move -3/30 and -2/50 LEDs/frame; blue base with cyan wave crests; no red or purple

definitions.label: 极光
definitions.description: 紫红光幕舒展，层层掠过机身。
definitions.rules: curtain=sin255(_frame*2+i*28), shimmer=sin255(_frame*3+i*17+96); phases move -2/28 and -3/17 LEDs/frame; ACTUAL native JavaScript simulator RGB is MAGENTA/PURPLE because ledHsv uses fractional region=h/60 with exact integer branch comparisons; follow actual RGB, not the green/cyan comment; no rainbow
